description: Two errors in daily review context passed to Chief: (1) Everbridge proposal value stated as $1.5M — correct figure is $150K. (2) Dinner with Derek/Don/jvaughan was a UTB regroup, not an Everbridge conversation. Chief was briefed with wrong deal value and wrong meeting context, producing incorrect questions to David.
correction: Everbridge proposal is $150K. The dinner (Regroup/Dinner) was UTB-related — jvaughan is a UTB contact, not Everbridge. These are separate accounts and should not be conflated.
systemic_fix: When passing context to sub-agents, cross-check attendee lists against known account contacts before attributing meeting context to a deal. Do not assume deal value from Knox ingest without verification.
